\/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPsychiatry posting:\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EDuring my psychiatry posting which was for 15 days I have known the psychiatric Importance in medicine and other I have seen different cases ( OCD, SCHIZOPHRENIA, DEPRESSION, ALCOHOL DEPENDENCE) I came to know about the importance of mental health with which so many people are suffering and which is hampering their PERSONAL life . \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EFollowing is the view of my case :\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EDate of admission : 12\/11\/2022\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EChief complaints months\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESlurring of speech since 3 months\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHistory of presenting illness:\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPatient was apparently asymptomatic 5 years ago then he developed tremors in upper limbs which was insidious in onset and gradually progressive and involved lower limbs,3 months back his speech got slurred, drooling of saliva started,since 2 months patient was unable to control micturition and he started to felt giddiness and falls suddenly while walking and he is complaining of constipation since 2
